title: spec.md (plan/sub-plan) runtime body-structure contract
description: Hook-consumable runtime artifact for plan-tree spec.md files. The k8s ValidatingAdmissionPolicy paramKind for plan spec.md, with file shapes optimized for LLM consumption.

_design_notes.consumer: librarian capabilities (plan-index); head-immutable is documentary — no write-time DENY (no immutability guard branch), a convention the plan author maintains once the head sections are frozen

amendment_pattern: post-Session-1 amendments append as §Session N amendments blocks; body preserved as historical record
